title: A comprehensive review of Double-Pulse resistance spot welding for enhanced weld quality and mechanical performance
authors: A.S. Adkine, Shantisagar K. Biradar
abstract: Abstract Resistance spot welding (RSW) has become a widely adopted joining technique in the automotive and structural manufacturing industries due to its high productivity, potential for automation and cost-effectiveness. However, conventional joining using single-pulse RSW frequently suffers from unstable nugget formation, expulsion, excessive heat accumulation and uneven mechanical performance, particularly in dissimilar material joints and advanced high-strength steels (AHSS). The Double-Plus Resistance Spot Welding (DP-RSW) method has emerged as an improvement where advanced current modulation approach enhances the quality of the joints formed by using a pre-heating pulse, an inter-pulse cooling phase and a subsequent high-current main pulse. This review critically examines the operating principle of DP-RSW process, temperature behavior, and properties of the weldments. A comprehensive discussion is presented of the impact of DP-RSW on nugget formation, tensile shear strength, failure energy, microstructural evolution and hardness distribution. When compared to conventional single-pulse welding it was found that DP-RSW provided superior temperature control, greater nugget consistency, decreased expulsion, narrower heat-affected zones and improved mechanical performance. Further, the applicability of DP-RSW in welding AHSS, stainless steels and dissimilar steel combinations used in lightweight automotive structures have been highlighted. Finally, recent developments in numerical modeling, statistical optimization, artificial neural networks and evolutionary algorithms for process optimization are summarized along with research gaps and future direction.
venue: Journal of Materials Science Materials in Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Double-pulse resistance spot welding improves nugget stability and mechanical performance by separating heating into a preheat, cooling interval, and main pulse.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The process is highly relevant for lightweight automotive and structural joints because it reduces expulsion, narrows the heat-affected zone, and performs better on AHSS, stainless steels, and dissimilar metals.
method: Apply a low-current preheating pulse to initiate controlled heating.
Insert an inter-pulse cooling phase to stabilize temperature rise.
Use a higher main pulse to complete nugget formation with improved consistency.
infographic.evidence_signal: The review synthesizes reported comparisons showing DP-RSW generally yields better temperature control, more consistent nuggets, higher tensile shear strength/failure energy, and reduced expulsion versus single-pulse welding.
infographic.watch_item: Benefits depend on careful pulse timing and current control; poorly tuned schedules may still cause uneven heating or incomplete nugget formation.
infographic.paper_title: A comprehensive review of Double-Pulse resistance spot welding for enhanced weld quality and mechanical performance

zh-Hans.title: 双脉冲电阻点焊在提升焊接质量和力学性能方面的综合综述
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 电阻点焊（RSW）由于其高生产率、自动化潜力和成本效益，已成为汽车和结构制造行业中广泛采用的连接技术。然而，采用单脉冲 RSW 的传统连接方式常常面临熔核形成不稳定、飞溅、热量过度积累以及力学性能不均匀等问题，尤其是在异种材料接头和先进高强钢（AHSS）中。双脉冲电阻点焊（DP-RSW）作为一种改进方法已被提出，其通过预热脉冲、脉间冷却阶段以及随后高电流主脉冲的高级电流调制方式，提高了所形成接头的质量。本综述系统考察了 DP-RSW 工艺的工作原理、温度行为以及焊接接头性能。文章全面讨论了 DP-RSW 对熔核形成、拉剪强度、失效能量、显微组织演变和硬度分布的影响。与传统单脉冲焊接相比，研究发现 DP-RSW 具有更优的温度控制、更高的熔核一致性、更少的飞溅、更窄的热影响区以及更好的力学性能。此外，还强调了 DP-RSW 在焊接 AHSS、不锈钢以及用于轻量化汽车结构的异种钢组合方面的适用性。最后，总结了数值建模、统计优化、人工神经网络和进化算法在工艺优化中的最新进展，并指出了研究空白和未来方向。

infographic.key_insight: 双脉冲电阻点焊通过将加热分为预热、冷却间隔和主脉冲三个阶段，提高了熔核稳定性和力学性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该工艺与轻量化汽车和结构接头密切相关，因为它可减少飞溅、缩小热影响区，并且在 AHSS、不锈钢和异种金属上的表现更优。
method: 施加低电流预热脉冲以启动可控加热。
加入脉间冷却阶段以稳定温升。
使用更高的主脉冲完成熔核形成并提高一致性。
infographic.evidence_signal: 该综述综合了已有比较结果，表明与单脉冲焊接相比，DP-RSW 通常具有更好的温度控制、更一致的熔核、更高的拉剪强度/失效能量以及更少的飞溅。
infographic.watch_item: 其优势取决于对脉冲时序和电流控制的精确设定；若工艺参数设定不当，仍可能出现加热不均或熔核形成不完全。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: A combined CEL simulation and ANN framework can accurately predict temperature, axial force, and defect formation in HDPE friction stir welding, enabling fast identification of robust processing windows.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study provides practical process maps for selecting rotation speed, welding speed, and bottom preheating to reduce wormhole defects and stabilize welding forces in thermoplastic joining.
method: 3D Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) finite-element model of HDPE FSW
Two multilayer perceptron ANNs trained on experimental thermal and force signals
Validation against experiments and generation of defect/no-defect process windows
infographic.evidence_signal: The ANN models achieved R² values between 0.91 and 0.99, and the CEL model matched experimental void formation, thermal response, and force trends.
infographic.watch_item: The workflow was validated on a limited experimental parameter space, so broader material grades, tool geometries, and thicknesses may require retraining and revalidation.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯摩擦搅拌焊焊接质量预测的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 摩擦搅拌焊（FSW）已被认可为一种高效连接热塑性材料的技术。本研究采用计算方法和机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）摩擦搅拌焊中的焊接温度、垂直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等FSW特征进行全面研究，并通过实验结果加以验证。建立了三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，以模拟在不同工艺参数（旋转速度、焊接速度以及底部预热条件）下的HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型与实验数据进行了对比验证，在预测孔洞形成、热响应和力学响应方面表现出显著良好的一致性。结果表明，对底表面进行预热可有效降低热梯度并稳定垂直力波动。定量而言，60 °C的底表面预热将峰值压入力从接近1600 N降低到约1100 N，并将峰值温度从70 °C（无预热）提高到约100 °C，从而平滑厚度方向梯度并稳定轴向力分布。与此同时，训练了两个基于实验数据的多层感知器人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测时间温度和轴向力响应，其R2介于0.91至0.99之间，表明在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高准确性和较强泛化能力。计算CEL模拟能够准确预测焊缝区形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；此外，结合CEL–ANN的框架可快速生成工艺图，突出显示有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接窗口，其中在1500 rpm和30 mm/min并配合60 °C预热时获得最佳条件，而在1000 rpm且无预热时由于虫孔形成而观察到较差的可焊性。这些结果为开发稳健的HDPE接头提供了基于工艺的设计指南，并展示了将计算建模与机器学习相结合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW过程的关键特征提供了宝贵见解，并支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 结合CEL模拟与ANN的框架能够准确预测HDPE摩擦搅拌焊中的温度、轴向力和缺陷形成，从而快速识别稳健的工艺窗口。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 本研究提供了实用的工艺图，可用于选择转速、焊接速度和底部预热，以减少热塑性连接中的虫孔缺陷并稳定焊接力。
method: HDPE摩擦搅拌焊的三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）有限元模型
两个基于实验热信号和力信号训练的多层感知器ANN
基于实验验证并生成有缺陷/无缺陷工艺窗口
infographic.evidence_signal: ANN模型的R²值达到0.91至0.99，CEL模型与实验中的孔洞形成、热响应和力趋势相匹配。
infographic.watch_item: 该工作流仅在有限的实验参数空间内进行了验证，因此更广泛的材料牌号、工具几何形状和厚度可能需要重新训练和重新验证。

title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
authors: Roshan Kuruvila, Mebin T Kuruvila, Manu Harilal, S. Thirumalai Kumaran
abstract: Cermet coating, which is a blend of ceramic hardness and metallic toughness, is mostly applied to enhance the wear and corrosion resistance of metals. Detonation gun ( D -gun) spraying is one of the most promising thermal spray technologies that would produce a high-quality ceramic coating. Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr coating is acceptable because of its superior mechanical characteristics and corrosion characteristic. The effectiveness of D -gun sprayed Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings was evaluated under aggressive acidic conditions using 1 M H₂SO₄, which serves as a standardized laboratory electrolyte for assessing corrosion resistance relevant to industrial acidic environments, including the key process variables such as spraying distance, which is critically important in the determination of other coating properties such as porosity, adhesion, roughness, and hardness. Duplex stainless steel (DSS) 2205 has been sprayed with Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr at three spraying distances; 170 mm, 180 mm and 190 mm in an attempt to conduct the research on the behavior of Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr in acid conditions. Electrochemical activity of the coating was evaluated in 1 M H 2 SO 4 solutions at room temperature; by open circuit potential (OCP), electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarisation. Investigation of surface morphology under SEM revealed dense lamellar coatings with porosity decreasing from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, indicating improved particle melting and coating compactness. The coating deposited at 190 mm exhibited the best electrochemical performance, with lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), compared with the uncoated substrate (2.60 mmpy). All coated specimens had a homogenous and compact coating structure. The results demonstrate that 190 mm is the optimum spray distance for producing high-integrity Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205, providing enhanced corrosion protection for components operating in aggressive acidic industrial environments. This work demonstrates that optimizing the D -gun spray distance significantly influences the microstructural integrity and electrochemical corrosion behaviour of Cr₃C₂–25NiCr coatings on DSS 2205. The established processing–microstructure–performance relationship provides a scientific basis for optimizing D -gun coating parameters to enhance corrosion resistance in aggressive acidic environments.

infographic.key_insight: A spray distance of 190 mm produced the most compact Cr3C2–NiCr coating on DSS 2205 and the best corrosion resistance in 1 M H2SO4.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing detonation-gun spray distance can significantly improve coating integrity and extend the life of stainless-steel components in acidic industrial service.
method: D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr onto DSS 2205 at 170, 180, and 190 mm.
Characterized coating structure with SEM and porosity measurements.
Evaluated corrosion behavior in 1 M H2SO4 using OCP, EIS, and potentiodynamic polarization.
infographic.evidence_signal: The 190 mm coating had the lowest reported corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), while porosity decreased from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm.
infographic.watch_item: The optimum distance is specific to the tested powder, substrate, and acid environment, so it should be revalidated before scaling to other systems or service conditions.
infographic.paper_title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments

zh-Hans.title: D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层喷涂距离对DSS 2205在酸性环境中的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 金属陶瓷涂层是陶瓷硬度与金属韧性的结合，主要用于提高金属的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。爆炸喷涂（D-gun）是最有前景的热喷涂技术之一，能够制备高质量的陶瓷涂层。Cr3C2-NiCr涂层因其优异的力学性能和耐腐蚀性能而具有较高的应用可行性。采用1 M H2SO4在强腐蚀性酸性条件下评估了D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的有效性；该溶液作为标准化实验室电解质，用于评估与工业酸性环境相关的耐蚀性，其中包括喷涂距离等关键工艺变量，而喷涂距离对孔隙率、结合强度、表面粗糙度和硬度等其他涂层性能的确定具有关键影响。采用Cr3C2-NiCr在170 mm、180 mm和190 mm三种喷涂距离下对双相不锈钢（DSS）2205进行喷涂，以研究Cr3C2-NiCr在酸性条件下的行为。通过开路电位（OCP）、电化学阻抗谱和动电位极化在室温下对1 M H2SO4溶液中的涂层电化学活性进行了评估。SEM下的表面形貌研究表明，涂层致密且呈层片状结构，孔隙率由170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，表明颗粒熔融更充分且涂层致密性更好。在190 mm处沉积的涂层表现出最佳电化学性能，其腐蚀速率最低，为0.113 mmpy，相比之下未涂层基体为2.60 mmpy。所有涂覆试样均具有均匀致密的涂层结构。结果表明，190 mm是制备DSS 2205上高完整性Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的最佳喷涂距离，可为在强酸性工业环境中服役的部件提供更优的耐腐蚀保护。本研究表明，优化D-gun喷涂距离会显著影响DSS 2205上Cr3C2–25NiCr涂层的微观结构完整性和电化学腐蚀行为。所建立的工艺–显微组织–性能关系为优化D-gun涂层参数、提高强酸环境下的耐腐蚀性提供了科学依据。

infographic.key_insight: 190 mm的喷涂距离在DSS 2205上形成了最致密的Cr3C2–NiCr涂层，并在1 M H2SO4中表现出最佳耐腐蚀性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化爆炸喷涂距离可显著提高涂层完整性，并延长不锈钢部件在酸性工业服役条件下的使用寿命。
method: 在DSS 2205上以170、180和190 mm的距离D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr。
采用SEM和孔隙率测量表征涂层结构。
在1 M H2SO4中使用OCP、EIS和动电位极化评估腐蚀行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 190 mm涂层的报告腐蚀速率最低，为0.113 mmpy，而孔隙率由170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%。
infographic.watch_item: 最佳距离取决于所测试的粉末、基体和酸性环境，因此在扩展到其他体系或服役条件之前应重新验证。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: Among WC-10Co-4Cr coatings, higher-velocity spray processes generally produced denser, harder coatings with better wear performance, while HVAF delivered the best overall corrosion resistance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This study helps select thermal spray routes for extending service life of stainless-steel components exposed to abrasion and corrosive environments.
method: Applied WC-10Co-4Cr coatings to 304 stainless steel using APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF.
Compared microstructure, Vickers hardness, friction/wear behavior, and electrochemical corrosion performance.
Ranked coating performance across the four spray technologies to identify process-dependent tradeoffs.
infographic.evidence_signal: Compared with bare 304 stainless steel, coating hardness increased to 771.4–1166.2 HV, wear rate dropped from 36.82×10^-5 to as low as 1.10×10^-5 mm3/N·m, and HVAF showed the best corrosion metrics (−0.37 VSCE, 1.75 μA/cm², 20438.5 Ω).
infographic.watch_item: Performance rankings are specific to the tested spray parameters, so process optimization and adhesion/density control are critical before transferring these results to other substrates or service conditions.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、高速氧燃料喷涂和高速空气燃料喷涂 WC-10Co-4Cr 硬质合金涂层的显微组织、耐磨性和耐腐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr 硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性能和耐腐蚀性能。分别采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和高速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，在 304 不锈钢基体上制备了 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层。系统研究并比较了 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层的显微组织、摩擦学性能和耐腐蚀性能。结果表明，采用 APS、DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 制备的硬质涂层的维氏硬度均高于 304 不锈钢，其值分别为 771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV 和 1162.2 HV。304 不锈钢的体积磨损率约为 (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m。APS、DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 涂层的体积磨损率均低于 304 不锈钢，分别约为 (7.93±0.30)×10-5、(1.51±0.20)×10-5、(1.17±0.10)×10-5 和 (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m。此外，304 不锈钢基体、APS 涂层、DS 涂层、HVOF 涂层和 HVAF 涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为 (0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01) 和 (0.43±0.01)。WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层的磨痕中可见剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于 APS 涂层。此外，HVOF 和 HVAF 涂层表现出更好的耐磨性能。耐腐蚀性能由高到低依次为 HVAF 涂层、DS 涂层、HVOF 涂层和 APS 涂层。其中，HVAF 涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位（-0.37±0.01 VSCE）、最小的腐蚀电流密度（1.75±0.02 μA/cm²）和最大的耐腐蚀电阻（20438.5 Ω）。APS 涂层在这四种涂层中的耐腐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: 在 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层中，更高速度的喷涂工艺通常可制备出更致密、更硬且耐磨性能更好的涂层，而 HVAF 具有最佳的整体耐腐蚀性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 本研究有助于为暴露于磨蚀和腐蚀环境中的不锈钢部件选择热喷涂工艺，以延长其服役寿命。
method: 采用 APS、DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 将 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层制备到 304 不锈钢上。
比较了显微组织、维氏硬度、摩擦/磨损行为以及电化学腐蚀性能。
对四种喷涂技术下的涂层性能进行排序，以识别与工艺相关的权衡关系。
infographic.evidence_signal: 与裸 304 不锈钢相比，涂层硬度提高至 771.4–1166.2 HV，磨损率从 36.82×10^-5 降至低至 1.10×10^-5 mm3/N·m，且 HVAF 表现出最佳腐蚀指标（−0.37 VSCE、1.75 μA/cm²、20438.5 Ω）。
infographic.watch_item: 性能排序仅针对所测试的喷涂参数，因此在将这些结果推广到其他基体或服役条件之前，工艺优化以及结合强度/致密度控制至关重要。

title: Interfacial Welding Enabled Hierarchical Silk Nanofibrous Aerogels for Thermal and Electromagnetic Protection in Extreme Environments
authors: Qiusheng Wang, Sijie Sun, Renchuan You, Junwei Chen, Shuqin Yan, Qiang Zhang
abstract: Abstract Advanced protective equipment operating in extreme environments urgently demands lightweight materials that integrate thermal insulation and electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding against severe thermal fluctuations and pervasive radiation. Herein, we report the hierarchical and mechanically robust silk nanofibrous aerogels (SNFAs) produced through a green interfacial-welding strategy. By utilizing waterborne polyurethane as a molecular solder to construct multi-site hydrogen bonding and chain entanglement at the contact nodes of natural silk nanofibrils, discrete building blocks are effectively transformed into an interconnected, load-bearing 3D network that suppresses structural collapse and effectively dissipates localized stress during deformation. Consequently, the SNFAs achieve an ultralow density (4 mg cm−3) and exceptional structural stability (compressive stress of 20.1 kPa at 80% strain). Benefiting from the slender solid pathways that minimize solid-phase heat conduction and the intact cellular walls that suppress gas convection, the aerogels demonstrate outstanding thermal insulation with a low thermal conductivity of 28.5 mW m−1 K−1. Furthermore, the introduction of carbon nanotubes endows the aerogels with efficient electrical transport and interfacial polarization, while the multi-tiered porous framework promotes repeated internal electromagnetic reflections, thereby yielding a remarkable EMI shielding effectiveness (40 dB) and electrical conductivity (139.3 S m−1). Collectively, this study presents an innovative welding approach that uses ductile polymer welding to overcome the fragility of natural nanofibrous assemblies, providing a sustainable and resilient framework for the development of next-generation multifunctional protective gear in extreme environments.

infographic.key_insight: A green interfacial-welding strategy uses waterborne polyurethane to “stitch” silk nanofibrils into a robust hierarchical aerogel that combines thermal insulation with EMI shielding.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The approach points to lightweight protective materials for extreme environments where mechanical durability, low heat transfer, and electromagnetic protection must coexist.
method: Use waterborne polyurethane as a molecular solder at silk nanofibril contact nodes
Build multi-site hydrogen bonding and chain entanglement to form an interconnected 3D network
Add carbon nanotubes to enable electrical conduction, interfacial polarization, and EMI shielding
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports ultralow density (4 mg cm−3), compressive stress of 20.1 kPa at 80% strain, thermal conductivity of 28.5 mW m−1 K−1, EMI shielding effectiveness of 40 dB, and conductivity of 139.3 S m−1.
infographic.watch_item: Performance may depend on maintaining the delicate porous architecture and uniform CNT dispersion during scale-up and under long-term environmental aging.
infographic.paper_title: Interfacial Welding Enabled Hierarchical Silk Nanofibrous Aerogels for Thermal and Electromagnetic Protection in Extreme Environments

zh-Hans.title: 界面焊接赋能的层级丝素纳米纤维气凝胶用于极端环境下的热防护与电磁防护
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 在极端环境中运行的先进防护装备迫切需要兼具轻质特性、热绝缘以及针对剧烈热波动和普遍辐射的电磁干扰（EMI）屏蔽能力的材料。在此，我们报道了一种通过绿色界面焊接策略制备的层级化且力学稳健的丝素纳米纤维气凝胶（SNFAs）。利用水性聚氨酯作为分子焊料，在天然丝素纳米纤维的接触节点处构建多位点氢键和链缠结，可将离散构筑单元有效转化为相互连通、承载负荷的三维网络，从而抑制结构塌陷，并在变形过程中有效耗散局部应力。因此，SNFAs 实现了超低密度（4 mg cm−3）和优异的结构稳定性（80% 应变下压缩应力为 20.1 kPa）。得益于细长的固体传热路径最小化了固相热传导，以及完整的胞壁抑制了气体对流，这些气凝胶表现出卓越的热绝缘性能，热导率低至 28.5 mW m−1 K−1。此外，引入碳纳米管赋予气凝胶高效的电荷传输和界面极化能力，而多层级多孔框架促进了内部电磁波的反复反射，从而获得了显著的 EMI 屏蔽效能（40 dB）和电导率（139.3 S m−1）。总体而言，本研究提出了一种创新的焊接方法，利用韧性聚合物焊接克服天然纳米纤维组装体的脆弱性，为在极端环境中开发下一代多功能防护装备提供了一种可持续且具韧性的框架。

infographic.key_insight: 绿色界面焊接策略利用水性聚氨酯将丝素纳米纤维“缝合”成一种兼具热绝缘与 EMI 屏蔽能力的稳健层级气凝胶。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该方法指向适用于极端环境的轻质防护材料，在此类环境中，机械耐久性、低热传递和电磁防护必须同时兼顾。
method: 将水性聚氨酯作为分子焊料作用于丝素纳米纤维接触节点
构建多位点氢键和链缠结，形成相互连通的三维网络
加入碳纳米管以实现电导、界面极化和 EMI 屏蔽
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了超低密度（4 mg cm−3）、80% 应变下 20.1 kPa 的压缩应力、28.5 mW m−1 K−1 的热导率、40 dB 的 EMI 屏蔽效能以及 139.3 S m−1 的电导率。
infographic.watch_item: 性能可能取决于在放大制备过程中以及长期环境老化下维持精细多孔结构和碳纳米管均匀分散的能力。

title: Microstructure and High-Temperature Oxidation Behaviour of HVOF and Plasma Sprayed Ni–Cr-Based Ceramic Coatings on SA516 Boiler Steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF-applied Ni-20Cr+40TiC produced the most oxidation-resistant coating on SA516 boiler steel, cutting high-temperature weight gain by 95.71% versus uncoated steel.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Dense Ni-Cr-based ceramic coatings can markedly improve boiler steel durability in cyclic 900°C oxidizing environments, making them promising for thermal protection of high-temperature components.
method: Prepared SA516 steel with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN coatings by HVOF and plasma spray.
Ran cyclic air oxidation for 50 cycles at 900°C.
Characterized phases and microstructure using XRD, SEM/EDS, and X-ray mapping.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports 50-cycle oxidation testing at 900°C, with the HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating showing the lowest mass gain and the uncoated steel suffering severe spalling and Fe2O3 formation.
infographic.watch_item: Performance is demonstrated under laboratory cyclic oxidation; long-term service behavior, thermal shock, and adhesion under real boiler conditions still need validation.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and High-Temperature Oxidation Behaviour of HVOF and Plasma Sprayed Ni–Cr-Based Ceramic Coatings on SA516 Boiler Steel

zh-Hans.title: HVOF和等离子喷涂Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层在SA516锅炉钢上的显微组织与高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用高速氧燃料喷涂（High Velocity Oxygen Fuel, HVOF）和等离子喷涂（Plasma Spray, PS）技术，研究了SA516锅炉钢表面Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层的显微组织及高温氧化行为。在900°C的模拟实验环境中进行了50次循环空气氧化试验，并通过X射线衍射（XRD）、带能量色散光谱的扫描电子显微镜（SEM/EDS）以及X射线面扫对所得显微组织和相变进行了分析。未涂层SA516钢的氧化层发生了严重剥落和开裂，形成了未受保护的相（Fe 2 O 3 ）。在所有涂层中，HVOF喷涂的Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层与裸SA516钢相比，使最大增重降低了95.71%，表明其具有更优异的抗氧化性能。涂层的这种增强性能归因于形成了致密的保护性氧化层，该氧化层由Cr 2 O 3 、TiO 2 、NiTiO 4 和NiO组成，同时伴随着孔隙率降低和显微硬度提高。

infographic.key_insight: HVOF制备的Ni-20Cr+40TiC在SA516锅炉钢上形成了最具抗氧化性的涂层，相比未涂层钢，其高温增重降低了95.71%。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 致密的Ni-Cr基陶瓷涂层可显著提高锅炉钢在900°C循环氧化环境中的耐久性，因此在高温部件热防护方面具有应用前景。
method: 采用HVOF和等离子喷涂制备SA516钢上的Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层。
在900°C下进行50次循环空气氧化。
使用XRD、SEM/EDS和X射线面扫对相结构和显微组织进行表征。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了在900°C下进行50次氧化循环，其中HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层表现出最低的质量增重，而未涂层钢则发生了严重剥落并形成Fe2O3。
infographic.watch_item: 该性能结果基于实验室循环氧化条件；在真实锅炉工况下的长期服役行为、热冲击性能和结合强度仍需验证。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, higher laser power and current increase molten-pool convection and penetration, while higher welding speed reduces heat input and shrinks the weld, with clear impacts on arc stability.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study provides process-window guidance for controlling weld shape, molten-pool flow, and arc behavior in low-thermal-expansion Invar components used for aerospace composite molds.
method: Numerical simulation of molten-pool morphology and fluid flow
High-speed photography of arc and pool behavior during welding
Parameter sweep across laser power, welding speed, and current
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports simulation and high-speed imaging evidence over laser power (5–6 kW), welding speed (0.5–0.8 m/min), and current (150–170 A), linking these settings to penetration, weld width, flow intensity, and arc deflection/stability.
infographic.watch_item: The conclusions are based on the tested parameter ranges, so transfer to other joint geometries, thicknesses, or material states may require re-optimization.
infographic.paper_title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此被广泛用于航空航天复合材料模具的制造。现有大多数研究主要集中于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，本文采用数值模拟和高速摄影分析了激光-TIG复合焊接Invar钢过程中不同工艺参数对熔池形貌演变和电弧特性的影响，这为优化Invar钢焊接工艺提供了重要的理论支撑。结果表明，在激光功率5 ~ 6 kW范围内，功率增加会导致更大的回弹压力，从而促进更大的熔深和小孔尺寸，增强整体熔池流动，并使电弧在高功率下更易受到激光吸引而发生偏转。在焊接速度0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min范围内，更高的速度会降低热输入，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，同时熔池流速和冷却速率增加；此外，高速度下电弧更易发生变形。在焊接电流150 ~ 170 A范围内，电流增加会增强电弧力，促进焊缝宽度扩展并强化熔池对流；此外，高电流下电弧更稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中，更高的激光功率和电流会增强熔池对流并增加熔深，而更高的焊接速度会降低热输入并缩小焊缝，同时对电弧稳定性产生明显影响。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究为控制用于航空航天复合材料模具的低热膨胀Invar部件的焊缝成形、熔池流动和电弧行为提供了工艺窗口指导。
method: 熔池形貌与流动的数值模拟
焊接过程中电弧与熔池行为的高速摄影
激光功率、焊接速度和电流的参数扫描
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了在激光功率（5–6 kW）、焊接速度（0.5–0.8 m/min）和电流（150–170 A）范围内的模拟与高速成像证据，并将这些参数与熔深、焊缝宽度、流动强度以及电弧偏转/稳定性联系起来。
infographic.watch_item: 结论基于所测试的参数范围，因此推广到其他接头形式、厚度或材料状态时可能需要重新优化。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: Homogeneous WC–Co–Cr powder produces dense, layered cermet coatings, while the spray process shifts the balance between hardness and tribological performance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Selecting DS or HVOF lets engineers tune WC–Co–Cr coatings for wear-resistant machine parts depending on whether maximum hardness or lower friction is the priority.
method: Compared detonation spray (DS) and high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) deposition of WC–Co–Cr coatings.
Characterized powder morphology and coating microstructure using SEM and EDS.
Compared phase/microstructure outcomes and tribological indicators across the two processes.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports an average microhardness of 1449 HV for DS coatings and a low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143) for HVOF coatings, supporting a process-dependent tradeoff in performance.
infographic.watch_item: Results depend strongly on powder homogeneity and spraying conditions, so the reported advantages may not transfer to poorly alloyed feedstock or different process settings.
infographic.paper_title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING

zh-Hans.title: 采用 HVOF 和爆炸喷涂制备的 WC–CO–CR 涂层结构形成与耐磨性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的 WC–Co–Cr 金属陶瓷涂层进行了对比分析。研究包括对初始粉末形貌的分析，以及利用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散光谱（EDS）对涂层显微组织和相组成的分析。结果表明，使用均匀、完全合金化的 WC–Co–Cr 粉末可确保形成致密的层状结构，且碳化物相在金属基体中分布均匀。爆炸喷涂可获得更高硬度的涂层（平均显微硬度为 1449 HV），而 HVOF 则可获得具有高致密度、均匀显微组织和低摩擦系数（Kt = 0.143）的涂层。对比分析证实，涂层的力学和摩擦学性能在很大程度上取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法。这些结果有助于确定 WC–Co–Cr 涂层的最佳工艺条件，提高机械零件的耐磨性和耐久性，这对于在强摩擦和高载荷条件下运行尤为重要。

infographic.key_insight: 均匀的 WC–Co–Cr 粉末可形成致密的层状金属陶瓷涂层，而喷涂工艺会改变硬度与摩擦学性能之间的平衡。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 根据是优先追求最高硬度还是更低摩擦，工程师可通过选择 DS 或 HVOF 来调控 WC–Co–Cr 涂层，用于耐磨机械零件。
method: 比较了采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）沉积的 WC–Co–Cr 涂层。
使用 SEM 和 EDS 对粉末形貌及涂层显微组织进行了表征。
比较了两种工艺下的相/显微组织结果和摩擦学指标。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了 DS 涂层的平均显微硬度为 1449 HV，而 HVOF 涂层的摩擦系数较低（Kt = 0.143），支持了性能随工艺而变化的权衡关系。
infographic.watch_item: 结果强烈依赖于粉末均匀性和喷涂条件，因此所报告的优势可能不适用于合金化不充分的原料或不同的工艺参数设置。

title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Laila Sulyubayeva, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: This study investigated the influence of detonation spraying parameters on the structure and tribological and mechanical properties of self-fluxing coatings of the Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C system. The investigated parameters included the barrel filling level (48–68%), the molar ratio of the working gases (O/C = 1.026–1.856), and the inter-shot delay (0–1 s). Morphological analysis of the coatings revealed a characteristic lamellar structure and a dependence of coating thickness and defect formation on the spraying conditions. A lower barrel filling level resulted in a denser coating structure with minimal porosity, whereas medium and high filling levels promoted the formation of microcracks, presumably due to increased residual stresses. Tribological tests showed that the minimum coefficient of friction was obtained at a barrel filling level of 48% (μ = 0.674 ± 0.136) and an O/C ratio of 1.026, but these conditions were also associated with increased wear. The highest wear resistance was obtained at an O/C ratio of 1.856 and an increased inter-shot delay of up to 1 s, resulting in a decrease in the specific wear rate to 0.000189 mm³/(N·m). Roughness analysis showed that increasing the inter-shot delay reduced Ra from 5.00 to 3.60 μm, which may be attributed to a reduction in thermal load and more favorable coating formation conditions. The maximum hardness, up to 905.6 HV, was obtained for a combination of parameters that promoted the formation of a dense structure and strengthening phases. The results indicate that optimizing the detonation spraying parameters requires a trade-off between reducing the coefficient of friction and increasing wear resistance. The findings can be used to develop tech nologies for the restoration and surface strengthening of machine components.
venue: Bulletin of the Karaganda University Physics Series

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed self-fluxing Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C coatings can be tuned from low-friction to high-wear-resistance behavior by adjusting barrel fill, gas ratio, and inter-shot delay.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study provides process windows for restoring and strengthening machine parts with coatings that balance hardness, porosity, surface roughness, and tribological performance.
method: Varied barrel filling level from 48–68%.
Adjusted working-gas molar ratio (O/C = 1.026–1.856).
Changed inter-shot delay from 0 to 1 s and compared coating microstructure, hardness, roughness, friction, and wear.
infographic.evidence_signal: At 48% barrel fill and O/C = 1.026 the coating reached the lowest friction (μ = 0.674 ± 0.136), while O/C = 1.856 with up to 1 s delay gave the best wear resistance (specific wear rate = 0.000189 mm³/(N·m)) and Ra dropped from 5.00 to 3.60 μm with longer delay.
infographic.watch_item: Optimizing for low friction can increase wear, so parameter selection requires a trade-off and may not transfer directly without matching spray equipment and part geometry.
infographic.paper_title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying

zh-Hans.title: 通过爆炸喷涂制备自熔性镍基涂层的方法开发
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了爆炸喷涂参数对 Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C 系统自熔性涂层结构以及摩擦学和力学性能的影响。研究参数包括炮管填充率（48–68%）、工作气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）以及两次喷射间隔（0–1 s）。对涂层的形貌分析表明，其具有典型的层状结构，且涂层厚度和缺陷形成依赖于喷涂条件。较低的炮管填充率有利于获得更致密、孔隙率更低的涂层结构，而中等和较高的填充率则促进了微裂纹的形成，这可能是由于残余应力增大所致。摩擦学测试表明，在炮管填充率为 48%（μ = 0.674 ± 0.136）且 O/C 比为 1.026 时获得了最低摩擦系数，但这些条件也伴随着较高的磨损。最高耐磨性出现在 O/C 比为 1.856 且两次喷射间隔增加至 1 s 的条件下，使比磨损率降低至 0.000189 mm³/(N·m)。粗糙度分析表明，增加两次喷射间隔可使 Ra 从 5.00 降至 3.60 μm，这可能归因于热负荷降低以及更有利的涂层形成条件。最高硬度可达 905.6 HV，出现在有利于形成致密结构和强化相的一组参数组合下。结果表明，爆炸喷涂参数优化需要在降低摩擦系数与提高耐磨性之间进行权衡。这些发现可用于开发机械零部件修复和表面强化技术。

infographic.key_insight: 通过调整炮管填充率、气体比和两次喷射间隔，爆炸喷涂的自熔性 Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C 涂层可由低摩擦行为调控为高耐磨行为。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究为采用涂层修复和强化机械零件提供了工艺窗口，可在硬度、孔隙率、表面粗糙度和摩擦学性能之间实现平衡。
method: 将炮管填充率从 48–68% 进行变化。
调整工作气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）。
将两次喷射间隔从 0 到 1 s 进行改变，并比较涂层微观结构、硬度、粗糙度、摩擦和磨损。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在炮管填充率为 48% 且 O/C = 1.026 时，涂层获得最低摩擦系数（μ = 0.674 ± 0.136）；而在 O/C = 1.856 且两次喷射间隔最高达 1 s 时，耐磨性最佳（比磨损率 = 0.000189 mm³/(N·m)），且随着间隔增大，Ra 从 5.00 降至 3.60 μm。
infographic.watch_item: 针对低摩擦进行优化可能会增加磨损，因此参数选择需要权衡，且若喷涂设备和零件几何形状不匹配，结果未必可直接迁移。

title: THE EFFECT OF THE COMPOSITION OF METAL-CERAMIC POWDERS ON THE STRUCTURE AND PERFORMANCE PROPERTIES OF COATINGS OBTAINED BY THE HVOF METHOD
authors: Yermakhan Molbossynov, Arystanbek Kussainov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Indira Abizhanova, Rashid Kuanyshbay, Abai Alimov
abstract: The article presents the results of a comprehensive study of WC–Co–Cr, WC–NiCr, WC–Ni, Cr₃C₂–NiCr, and Al₂O₃–NiCr cermet coatings deposited onto a 65G steel substrate by the high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) spraying method. An analysis of the microstructure (SEM/EDS), microhardness, surface roughness, tribological characteristics, and adhesive strength of the coatings was carried out. It was established that the composition of the powder mixture and the characteristics of the binder phase significantly affect the formation of the structure and performance properties of the coatings. The WC–Co–Cr coating formed the densest and most structurally homogeneous lamellar structure, demonstrating the lowest coefficient of friction (μ = 0.143), the highest microhardness (1316.87 HV), and high resistance to scratch loading. The Cr₃C₂–NiCr and WC–NiCr coatings showed satisfactory tribological characteristics (μ = 0.310 and 0.326, respectively); however, reduced adhesive strength was observed for the Cr₃C₂–NiCr coating. The WC–Ni coating was characterized by an increased coefficient of friction (0.545) at moderate hardness values (721.2 HV). The highest coefficient of friction was found for the Al₂O₃–NiCr coating (0.630), while this system also demonstrated the lowest microhardness (631.59 HV) and instability in structure formation. The surface roughness of the coatings was in the range of Ra = 3.881–8.130 μm and depended on the spraying conditions. The obtained results made it possible to determine that the WC–Co–Cr coating provides the optimal combination of mechanical and tribological properties and is the most promising for application under conditions of intensive abrasive-adhesive wear in mechanical engineering, power engineering, and metallurgy.

infographic.key_insight: Among the tested HVOF cermet coatings, WC–Co–Cr delivered the best overall balance of dense microstructure, highest hardness, and lowest friction, making it the top performer.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear-critical machine and power-engineering parts, coating composition and binder selection strongly control durability, adhesion, and tribological performance.
method: HVOF-sprayed WC–Co–Cr, WC–NiCr, WC–Ni, Cr3C2–NiCr, and Al2O3–NiCr coatings onto 65G steel.
Characterized microstructure by SEM/EDS and measured microhardness, roughness, friction, and adhesive strength.
Compared performance across coatings to identify the most wear-resistant formulation.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports measured outcomes including friction coefficients, microhardness values, surface roughness, and scratch/adhesion behavior, with WC–Co–Cr showing μ = 0.143 and 1316.87 HV.
infographic.watch_item: Performance depends on spraying conditions and adhesion can drop for some compositions, so process control is critical before scale-up.
infographic.paper_title: THE EFFECT OF THE COMPOSITION OF METAL-CERAMIC POWDERS ON THE STRUCTURE AND PERFORMANCE PROPERTIES OF COATINGS OBTAINED BY THE HVOF METHOD

zh-Hans.title: 金属-陶瓷粉末组成对采用HVOF方法获得的涂层结构和性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对通过高速火焰喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积于65G钢基体上的WC–Co–Cr、WC–NiCr、WC–Ni、Cr₃C₂–NiCr和Al₂O₃–NiCr金属陶瓷涂层进行了综合研究。对涂层的显微组织（SEM/EDS）、显微硬度、表面粗糙度、摩擦学特性和黏附强度进行了分析。研究表明，粉末混合物的组成以及粘结相的特性会显著影响涂层结构和性能的形成。WC–Co–Cr涂层形成了最致密、结构最均匀的层状组织，表现出最低的摩擦系数（μ = 0.143）、最高的显微硬度（1316.87 HV）以及较高的抗划痕载荷能力。Cr₃C₂–NiCr和WC–NiCr涂层表现出较为满意的摩擦学特性（分别为μ = 0.310和0.326）；然而，Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的黏附强度较低。WC–Ni涂层在中等硬度值（721.2 HV）下表现出较高的摩擦系数（0.545）。Al₂O₃–NiCr涂层的摩擦系数最高（0.630），同时该体系还表现出最低的显微硬度（631.59 HV）以及结构形成的不稳定性。涂层表面粗糙度范围为Ra = 3.881–8.130 μm，并取决于喷涂条件。所得结果表明，WC–Co–Cr涂层在力学和摩擦学性能之间提供了最佳组合，并且在机械工程、电力工程和冶金领域的强烈磨粒-黏着磨损条件下最具应用前景。

infographic.key_insight: 在所测试的HVOF金属陶瓷涂层中，WC–Co–Cr在致密显微组织、最高硬度和最低摩擦之间实现了最佳综合平衡，是表现最优的涂层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于耐磨关键的机械和电力工程部件，涂层组成和粘结相选择会强烈控制耐久性、黏附性和摩擦学性能。
method: 将WC–Co–Cr、WC–NiCr、WC–Ni、Cr3C2–NiCr和Al2O3–NiCr涂层通过HVOF喷涂到65G钢上。
采用SEM/EDS表征显微组织，并测量显微硬度、粗糙度、摩擦和黏附强度。
比较不同涂层的性能，以确定最耐磨的配方。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了测得的摩擦系数、显微硬度值、表面粗糙度以及划痕/黏附行为，其中WC–Co–Cr的μ = 0.143、显微硬度为1316.87 HV。
infographic.watch_item: 性能取决于喷涂条件，且某些成分的黏附性可能下降，因此在规模化之前过程控制至关重要。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.key_insight: Stacking ensemble learning delivered the most accurate task-specific predictions, while multitask neural networks provided strong shared-learning performance across the related welding outputs.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study helps welding engineers choose between a shared-model approach for correlated quality metrics and a higher-accuracy ensemble approach for individual property prediction.
method: Compared a multitask neural network (shared hidden layers with task-specific outputs) against stacking ensemble learning.
Predicted three welding properties: UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness.
Evaluated both models using RMSE and R² on the same shared dataset.
infographic.evidence_signal: Stacking achieved lower RMSE and higher R² for all three targets in most cases, with especially strong results for UTS (RMSE 0.0263, R² 0.9863) and weld hardness (RMSE 0.0467, R² 0.9782).
infographic.watch_item: Performance is reported on a shared dataset, so practical deployment should verify generalization on new welding conditions, materials, and process settings.
infographic.paper_title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications

zh-Hans.title: 多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习在焊接应用中预测UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的对比分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测焊接性能指标，如极限强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和热影响区（HAZ）力学硬度，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和服役性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是指一种机器学习方法，其中一个模型被设计用于同时处理多个相互关联的任务。MTL不是为每个任务分别训练独立模型，而是在任务之间共享表征，使其能够利用共同模式，同时保持任务特定差异。本研究基于同一数据集，对两种先进机器学习技术，即多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习，用于预测这些参数进行了比较。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是一种特定的多任务学习（MTL）模型，采用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在MTNN中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时具有任务特定的输出层。这种共享表征使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保持任务特定输出。两种方法均使用RMSE和R²进行评估，以确定其预测精度和整体效果。结果显示，该方法具有较强的预测能力，其RMSE分别为UTS 0.1288、焊缝硬度0.0886和HAZ硬度0.1125，而R²值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。这表明其在相关任务中具有良好的泛化能力。堆叠集成学习在单项任务预测精度方面优于MTL：UTS的RMSE为0.0263，R²为0.9863；焊缝硬度的RMSE为0.0467，R²为0.9782；HAZ硬度的RMSE为0.1109，R²为0.8453。这些结果表明，集成方法在生成高精度、任务特定预测方面具有良好能力。该对比揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL适用于任务相关且数据稀疏的场景，具有高效训练和良好泛化能力；堆叠集成在需要高精度、独立预测的情况下表现更佳。在这两种情况下，它们都显示出提升焊接应用预测能力的显著潜力，因此适合作为进一步研究将两种方法优势结合起来的混合模型的前期基础。

infographic.key_insight: 堆叠集成学习在任务特定预测方面提供了最准确的结果，而多任务神经网络则在相关焊接输出上展现出较强的共享学习性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究有助于焊接工程师在相关质量指标的共享模型方法与单一性能预测的高精度集成方法之间做出选择。
method: 将多任务神经网络（共享隐藏层并具有任务特定输出）与堆叠集成学习进行了比较。
预测了三种焊接性能：UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度。
在同一共享数据集上使用RMSE和R²评估了两种模型。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在大多数情况下，堆叠方法在三个目标上均实现了更低的RMSE和更高的R²，尤其是在UTS（RMSE 0.0263，R² 0.9863）和焊缝硬度（RMSE 0.0467，R² 0.9782）方面表现突出。
infographic.watch_item: 性能结果基于共享数据集报告，因此实际部署时应在新的焊接条件、材料和工艺参数下验证其泛化能力。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed Fe-based amorphous coatings with better droplet spreading form denser microstructures that improve corrosion resistance and reduce wear, especially in humid environments.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing spray parameters and controlling porosity can extend the service life of Fe-based protective coatings on carbon steel in corrosive and tribological applications.
method: Prepared Fe-based amorphous coatings on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters.
Evaluated coating microstructure, long-term corrosion behavior, and tribological performance across humidity conditions.
Related droplet morphology, porosity, and tribo-chemical interactions to corrosion and wear outcomes.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports systematic corrosion and wear testing showing that higher porosity worsens long-term corrosion resistance, while increasing humidity lowers friction coefficient and wear rate.
infographic.watch_item: Results depend strongly on spray parameter control and humidity; scaling to service conditions may require careful validation of porosity and environmental variability.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 不同湿度环境下Fe基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为与磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂在不同喷涂参数下成功制备了Q235碳钢上的Fe基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀与摩擦学行为。液滴呈盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷并形成具有致密微观结构的细层片状涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷发生率较高与长期耐腐蚀性能降低相关。此外，在不同湿度条件下，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应在涂层的磨损行为中起重要作用。随着湿度条件升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

infographic.key_insight: 通过爆炸喷涂获得铺展更好的Fe基非晶涂层可形成更致密的微观结构，从而提升耐腐蚀性并降低磨损，尤其是在潮湿环境中。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.engineering_relevance: Process-gas control is an effective lever for tuning coating quality in flame-sprayed wear- and corrosion-resistant layers on AISI 321 steel.

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究探讨了火焰喷涂工艺参数对 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔性涂层显微组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的 AISI 321 奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料。涂层通过使用 Metal Coat 6PM-II 系统的火焰喷涂方法制备。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧/乙炔（O₂/C₂H₂）比调整为 1.0、1.1 和 1.2。喷涂参数采用 Accuraspray 4.0 诊断系统进行监测。对所得涂层的显微组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行了表征。提高 O₂/C₂H₂ 比可使涂层结构致密化，并使孔隙率从 1.97 ± 0.13% 降至 0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度从 4.70 ± 0.09 μm 降至 2.99 ± 0.11 μm，而结合强度从 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa 增至 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。当 O₂/C₂H₂ 比为 1.1 时，获得了最高平均显微硬度 1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 制备的涂层表现出最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，同时具有最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制 O₂/C₂H₂ 比是调控火焰喷涂 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔性涂层显微结构和力学特性的有效手段。

infographic.key_insight: 提高火焰喷涂 O2/C2H2 比使 Ni–Cr–B–Si 自熔性涂层更致密、结合更好，而 1.2 时整体表面质量和结合性能最佳。

infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告孔隙率从 1.97 ± 0.13% 降至 0.90 ± 0.09%，粗糙度从 4.70 ± 0.09 μm 降至 2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度从 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa 升至 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa，并且在 O2/C2H2 = 1.1 时获得峰值显微硬度 1051.7 HV。

title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation
authors: Muntadher Saleh Mahdi, Ayad M. Takhakh, Mohamed Hamdy Doweidar
abstract: Distal Weight-Bearing Implants (DWBIs) represent a clinically emerging class of load-bearing medical devices in which biomaterial design, surface architecture, and biomechanical performance are tightly coupled. Their success depends not only on restoring distal support in transfemoral rehabilitation, but also on the ability of metallic, ceramic, and composite biomaterial interfaces to sustain cyclic loading while promoting durable bone-implant integration. However, distal support also changes bending moments, shear stresses, micromotion, coating durability, and biological demands at the bone-implant interface. This systematic review synthesizes DWBI concepts, geometry optimization, finite element analysis with gait-phase loading, Functionally Graded Materials (FGMs), graded Ti-HAp (hydroxyapatite) architectures, in-vivo osseointegration evidence, and clinical translation pathways. A quantitative trend analysis was performed on 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies to assess trends, validation depth, and translation readiness. However, more than half of the empirical evidence remained at the bench or simulation level, while animal and human/clinical studies formed a smaller validation layer. HAp-centered surface or bulk material engineering represented a substantial share of the corpus; however, evidence for graded Ti-HAp/FGM architectures was derived predominantly from non-DWBI biomaterial and mechanistic analog studies, supporting mechanistic plausibility rather than DWBI-specific validation. Mechanistically, DWBI should be interpreted as an integrated biomaterial-mechanical system linking macro-geometry, metallic/ceramic surface architecture, graded Ti-HAp interfaces, gait-phase loading, tribology/corrosion behavior, in-vivo fixation, and clinical workflow. Translation will require patient-realistic loading conditions, validated finite element analysis workflows, device-level fatigue and coating-integrity testing, standardized in-vivo endpoints, harmonized rehabilitation protocols, and registry-supported clinical follow-up linking mechanical plausibility to durable biological fixation and patient-level benefit.

infographic.key_insight: Distal weight-bearing implants work best as an integrated biomechanical-biomaterial system, where geometry, graded surfaces, and cyclic loading jointly determine fixation durability and osseointegration.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For implant designers, the study highlights that translational success depends on validated gait-phase finite element models, fatigue-resistant interfaces, and clinically robust coating or graded-material strategies.

infographic.watch_item: Graded Ti-HAp and FGM concepts appear promising, but much of the supporting evidence is indirect rather than DWBI-specific, so device-level validation is still needed.
infographic.paper_title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation

zh-Hans.title: 远端承重植入物的生物材料与生物力学设计：计算建模、生物材料界面与临床转化
zh-Hans.abstract: 远端承重植入物（DWBIs）代表一类临床新兴的承载型医疗器械，其生物材料设计、表面结构与生物力学性能高度耦合。其成功不仅取决于在股骨假肢康复中恢复远端支撑，还取决于金属、陶瓷和复合生物材料界面在促进持久骨-植入物整合的同时承受循环载荷的能力。然而，远端支撑也会改变弯矩、剪应力、微动、涂层耐久性以及骨-植入物界面的生物学需求。本系统综述综合了DWBI概念、几何优化、结合步态相位载荷的有限元分析、功能梯度材料（FGMs）、梯度Ti-HAp（羟基磷灰石）结构、体内骨整合证据以及临床转化路径。我们对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行了定量趋势分析，以评估趋势、验证深度和转化就绪程度。然而，超过一半的实证证据仍停留在台架或仿真层面，而动物和人体/临床研究构成了较小的验证层级。以HAp为中心的表面或本体材料工程占据了相当比例的文献；然而，关于梯度Ti-HAp/FGM结构的证据主要来源于非DWBI生物材料和机理类类比研究，支持的是机理上的可行性，而非DWBI特异性验证。从机理上看，DWBI应被理解为一个整合的生物材料-力学系统，连接宏观几何、金属/陶瓷表面结构、梯度Ti-HAp界面、步态相位载荷、摩擦学/腐蚀行为、体内固定以及临床流程。转化将需要符合患者真实情况的载荷条件、经过验证的有限元分析工作流程、器械级疲劳与涂层完整性测试、标准化体内终点、统一的康复方案，以及由注册数据库支持的临床随访，以将力学可行性与持久的生物学固定及患者层面的获益联系起来。

infographic.key_insight: 远端承重植入物在作为一个整合的生物力学-生物材料系统时表现最佳，其中几何形态、梯度表面与循环载荷共同决定固定耐久性和骨整合。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于植入物设计者而言，本研究强调，转化成功取决于经过验证的步态相位有限元模型、抗疲劳界面，以及临床上稳健的涂层或梯度材料策略。
method: 对DWBI设计、生物材料和转化研究进行系统综述
有限元分析与步态相位载荷概念

infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告的证据基础呈混合状态：大多数研究处于台架水平或基于仿真，而动物和临床验证仍然有限。
infographic.watch_item: 梯度Ti-HAp和FGM概念看起来很有前景，但支持它们的大部分证据是间接的，而非DWBI特异性的，因此仍需要器械级验证。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

infographic.key_insight: A drilled-to-bossed faying-surface geometry, combined with tuned DDFW parameters, substantially improves AA2024-T351 joint strength and is well captured by deep learning predictors.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study offers a practical route to stronger lightweight aluminum welds for aerospace and automotive structures while also demonstrating data-driven process optimization for welding.
method: L18 orthogonal array testing of friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, geometry, and friction time
Direct drive friction welding trials on a customized engine lathe
Deep learning comparison using an ensemble residual network, compact attention network, and adaptive multiscale network

infographic.watch_item: The predictive accuracy is moderate rather than near-perfect, so broader validation on additional weld conditions and independent datasets would be needed before deployment.
infographic.paper_title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding

zh-Hans.title: 利用钻孔凸台几何和深度学习预测提升AA2024-T351在直接驱动摩擦焊中的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 随着航空航天和汽车工业对轻质、高强度材料需求的不断增长，AA2024-T351 等铝合金因其优异的强度重量比而备受关注。然而，在这类合金中获得可靠接头仍然是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究聚焦于优化 AA2024-T351 直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）的工艺参数。受传统榫卯接头启发，提出一种新型钻孔凸台几何结构，以增强机械互锁并改善焊缝完整性。采用 L18 正交表系统设计试验，以评估拉伸强度和扭转强度。试验在定制发动机车床上进行，并选取摩擦压力、锻压压力、主轴转速、接合面几何形状和摩擦时间作为可控工艺参数。与此同时，实施了先进的深度学习模型，包括集成残差网络、紧凑注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络，用于基于焊接条件预测极限拉伸强度。结果表明，30 MPa 摩擦压力、70 MPa 锻压压力、2200 rpm 主轴转速、钻孔凸台几何结构以及 4 min 摩擦时间的最优参数组合表现出优异的力学性能，拉伸强度达到 538 MPa，扭转强度达到 325 MPa。与常规平面对平面接头相比，钻孔凸台结构显示出显著更高的接头强度。此外，在深度学习模型中，集成残差网络取得了最高预测精度，R² 值约为 0.81，有效捕捉了工艺参数与焊接强度之间的复杂关系。

infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究为航空航天和汽车结构提供了一条获得更高强度轻质铝焊接接头的实用途径，同时也展示了面向焊接的数据驱动工艺优化方法。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed titanium dioxide-based coatings can have their roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity tuned by adjusting spraying parameters, especially nozzle speed and spray distance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study provides practical process–property relationships and predictive equations that can help optimize coating production for surfaces requiring controlled wettability and morphology.
method: Varied detonation spraying process conditions for titanium-based metal-ceramic coatings.
Measured surface roughness, coating thickness, and hydrophobicity/contact angle.

zh-Hans.title: 通过爆炸喷涂在不同工艺条件下获得的钛基涂层表面特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 描述了基于二氧化钛的金属陶瓷涂层表面性质与爆炸喷涂条件之间的依赖关系。研究发现，表面粗糙度、表面厚度及其疏水性等性质，可通过在生产过程中选择喷涂工艺参数的特定取值来加以控制。确定了爆炸喷涂工艺参数的最佳取值，可使所制备涂层具有最大的疏水性。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度随喷嘴通过速度变化，并符合反幂律关系。粗糙度和接触角随喷涂距离变化，并符合抛物线规律。获得了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面特性，以及确定涂层喷涂的最佳工艺模式，从而保证其最佳疏水性。

infographic.key_insight: 通过调节喷涂参数，尤其是喷嘴速度和喷涂距离，可以调控爆炸喷涂二氧化钛基涂层的粗糙度、厚度和疏水性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究提供了实用的工艺—性能关系和预测方程，有助于优化涂层制备工艺，适用于需要可控润湿性和形貌的表面。
method: 改变钛基金属陶瓷涂层的爆炸喷涂工艺条件。
测量表面粗糙度、涂层厚度以及疏水性/接触角。
拟合喷嘴速度和喷涂距离与表面响应之间的经验规律。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告称，粗糙度和厚度随喷嘴通过速度呈反幂律关系，而粗糙度和接触角随喷涂距离呈抛物线依赖关系。

title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, Indira Abizhanova, M.K. Kaliaskarova, Yermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов
abstract: The hardness and post-scratch surface morphology of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings subjected to ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) were examined for detonation-sprayed (DS) and high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) deposits. Four treated samples per deposition route were evaluated at static loads of 20 and 30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20 and 30 µm. Instrumental hardness was measured at a load of 300 mN with a dwell time of 10 s. The DS samples exhibited hardness values of 820–970 HV, whereas the HVOF samples covered the wider range of 546–1165 HV. The highest values were recorded for DS-T1 at 20 N/20 µm and HVOF-T4 at 30 N/30 µm. SEM fields acquired after scratch testing showed heterogeneous surface contrast and crack-like discontinuities in both coating series. These observations provide qualitative evidence of the post-test surface condition but do not isolate damage caused by UNSM or establish a ranking of scratch resistance. Available mean friction coefficients are reported as supplementary observations for six treated samples. The results demonstrate a sample-dependent hardness response and emphasize the need to assess local mechanical properties together with surface integrity.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: Ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification increased the local hardness of Cr3C2–NiCr coatings, but the response depended strongly on deposition route and treatment condition.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study suggests UNSM can improve surface-mechanical performance of thermal-spray coatings, but process optimization must account for coating-specific variability and post-scratch integrity.
method: Compared detonation-sprayed and HVOF Cr3C2–NiCr coatings after UNSM.
Tested four treatment conditions per route using 20/30 N static loads and 20/30 µm vibration amplitudes.
Measured instrumental hardness at 300 mN and examined scratch-track morphology by SEM.
infographic.evidence_signal: Hardness ranged from 820–970 HV for detonation-sprayed samples and 546–1165 HV for HVOF samples, with heterogeneous SEM features and crack-like discontinuities after scratch testing.
infographic.watch_item: The scratch observations are qualitative and do not isolate damage caused specifically by UNSM, so scratch resistance ranking should be treated cautiously.
infographic.paper_title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION

zh-Hans.title: 超声纳米晶表面改性后 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层的硬度与划痕后表面形貌
zh-Hans.abstract: 研究了经超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）处理的 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层在爆炸喷涂（DS）和高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）沉积条件下的硬度与划痕后表面形貌。对每种沉积路线的四个处理样品进行了评估，静载荷分别为 20 和 30 N，振动幅值分别为 20 和 30 µm。采用 300 mN 载荷、10 s 保载时间测量仪器硬度。DS 样品的硬度为 820–970 HV，而 HVOF 样品的硬度范围更宽，为 546–1165 HV。最高值分别出现在 20 N/20 µm 条件下的 DS-T1 和 30 N/30 µm 条件下的 HVOF-T4。划痕测试后采集的 SEM 图像在两类涂层中均显示出不均匀的表面对比度和类似裂纹的不连续特征。这些观察为测试后的表面状态提供了定性证据，但并未将损伤明确归因于 UNSM，也未建立划痕抗力的排序。所获得的平均摩擦系数作为六个处理样品的补充观察结果予以报告。结果表明，硬度响应具有样品依赖性，并强调需要将局部力学性能与表面完整性结合评估。

infographic.key_insight: 超声纳米晶表面改性提高了 Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层的局部硬度，但其响应强烈依赖于沉积路线和处理条件。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究表明，UNSM 可提升热喷涂涂层的表面力学性能，但工艺优化必须考虑涂层特有的变异性以及划痕后的完整性。
method: 比较了爆炸喷涂和 HVOF Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层在 UNSM 处理后的性能。
对每种路线测试了四种处理条件，静载荷为 20/30 N，振动幅值为 20/30 µm。
在 300 mN 下测量仪器硬度，并通过 SEM 检查划痕轨迹形貌。
infographic.evidence_signal: 爆炸喷涂样品的硬度范围为 820–970 HV，HVOF 样品为 546–1165 HV；划痕测试后 SEM 特征不均匀，并出现类似裂纹的不连续现象。
infographic.watch_item: 划痕观察仅为定性结果，且未将损伤明确归因于 UNSM，因此划痕抗力排序应谨慎解读。

title: STUDY OF TRIBOLOGICAL PROPERTIES OF BIOCOATINGS BY DETONATION SPRAYING METHOD
authors: Жұлдыз Болатқызы Сағдолдина, Daryn Baizhan, Temirlan Alimbekuly, Akbar S. Alibekov
abstract: In this study, bioactive hydroxyapatite coatings were deposited on commercially pure Grade 2 titanium substrates by detonation spraying at different O₂/C₂H₂ ratios in the range of 2.6-3.7. X-ray diffraction analysis confirmed the predominance of the hydroxyapatite phase with partial formation of α-tricalcium phosphate, which is attributed to high temperatures and intense dynamic processes in the detonation jet. The formed coatings exhibit pronounced hydrophobicity, high structural heterogeneity, and a well-developed surface microrelief, promoting improved interaction with bone tissue and accelerated osseointegration. Tribological tests conducted under dry conditions and in Ringer’s solution demonstrated a significant increase in wear resistance compared to uncoated Grade 2 titanium. The best friction characteristics and the lowest wear volume were observed for coatings deposited at O₂/C₂H₂ ratios of 3.0 and 3.3, which is associated with an optimal combination of crystallinity, phase composition, and adhesion strength. Coatings formed under these conditions provide stable tribological behavior in physiological environments. The obtained results confirm the prospects of detonation-sprayed hydroxyapatite for improving the durability, biocompatibility, and operational reliability of titanium implants.
venue: Bulletin of Shakarim University Technical Sciences

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed hydroxyapatite coatings on Grade 2 titanium deliver the best tribological performance at intermediate O₂/C₂H₂ ratios, especially 3.0–3.3.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study suggests a practical route to improve titanium implant wear resistance and physiological durability while supporting bioactivity and osseointegration.
method: Deposited hydroxyapatite on commercially pure Grade 2 Ti using detonation spraying.
Varied O₂/C₂H₂ ratio from 2.6 to 3.7 to tune coating structure and phase composition.
Compared tribological behavior in dry conditions and in Ringer’s solution.
infographic.evidence_signal: XRD showed mostly hydroxyapatite with some α-tricalcium phosphate, and wear testing found the lowest wear and best friction at O₂/C₂H₂ ratios of 3.0 and 3.3.
infographic.watch_item: High-temperature detonation spraying can introduce phase changes and coating heterogeneity, so process control is critical to avoid performance variability.
infographic.paper_title: STUDY OF TRIBOLOGICAL PROPERTIES OF BIOCOATINGS BY DETONATION SPRAYING METHOD

zh-Hans.title: 爆轰喷涂法制备生物涂层摩擦学性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用爆轰喷涂在不同 O₂/C₂H₂ 比值（范围为 2.6–3.7）条件下，将生物活性羟基磷灰石涂层沉积于商用纯 2 级钛基体上。X 射线衍射分析证实，羟基磷灰石相占主导，同时部分形成了 α-磷酸三钙，这归因于爆轰射流中的高温和强烈动态过程。所形成的涂层表现出明显的疏水性、高结构非均匀性以及发育良好的表面微观起伏，有助于增强与骨组织的相互作用并加速骨结合。于干摩擦条件和 Ringer 溶液中进行的摩擦学测试表明，与未涂层的 2 级钛相比，其耐磨性显著提高。在 O₂/C₂H₂ 比值为 3.0 和 3.3 时制备的涂层表现出最佳摩擦特性和最小磨损体积，这与结晶度、相组成和附着强度的最优组合有关。在这些条件下形成的涂层在生理环境中具有稳定的摩擦学行为。所得结果证实，爆轰喷涂羟基磷灰石在提高钛植入体的耐久性、生物相容性和服役可靠性方面具有应用前景。

infographic.key_insight: 爆轰喷涂羟基磷灰石涂层在 2 级钛上的最佳摩擦学性能出现在中等 O₂/C₂H₂ 比值下，尤其是 3.0–3.3。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究表明了一条切实可行的途径，可在保持生物活性和骨结合能力的同时，提高钛植入体的耐磨性和生理环境耐久性。
method: 采用爆轰喷涂在商用纯 2 级 Ti 上沉积羟基磷灰石。
将 O₂/C₂H₂ 比值从 2.6 调整到 3.7，以调控涂层结构和相组成。
比较了干摩擦条件和 Ringer 溶液中的摩擦学行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: XRD 显示以羟基磷灰石为主并含有少量 α-磷酸三钙，磨损测试发现 O₂/C₂H₂ 比值为 3.0 和 3.3 时磨损最小、摩擦性能最佳。
infographic.watch_item: 高温爆轰喷涂可能引入相变和涂层非均匀性，因此过程控制对于避免性能波动至关重要。

title: Synthesis of Amorphous and Crystalline Silicon Dioxide Powder Composites from Rice Husk Ash for Thermal Spray Deposit
authors: Daryn Baizhan, Temirlan Alimbekuly, Akbar S. Alibekov, Elzhan Birzhan, G.S. Bektasova, Жұлдыз Болатқызы Сағдолдина
abstract: This paper presents the synthesis of silicon dioxide (SiO₂) from rice husk ash through chemical treatment followed by heat treatment at 800 °C for 3 h. The structural and physicochemical properties of the synthesized silica were investigated using X-ray diffraction (XRD), Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), and laser diffraction particle size analysis. The synthesized silica exhibited an amorphous structure, with a median particle size (D50) of approximately 88.9 μm. Subsequent annealing at 1200 °C led to crystallization of the silica, resulting in the formation of quartz and cristobalite phases. FTIR analysis revealed characteristic absorption bands associated with Si–O–Si stretching vibrations in the 1000–1100 cm⁻¹ region, as well as bands attributed to hydroxyl groups. The obtained crystalline silica materials demonstrate potential for use as powder materials in thermal spraying technologies.
venue: Bulletin of the Karaganda University Physics Series

infographic.key_insight: Rice husk ash can be converted into silica powder that is amorphous after 800 °C treatment and becomes crystalline quartz/cristobalite after 1200 °C annealing.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This offers a low-cost, waste-derived feedstock for thermal spray powder development, with phase control enabling tuning of coating precursor properties.
method: Chemically treat rice husk ash to extract SiO2.
Heat treat the extracted material at 800 °C for 3 h to obtain amorphous silica.
Anneal at 1200 °C to induce crystallization into quartz and cristobalite.
infographic.evidence_signal: XRD, FTIR, and laser diffraction showed an amorphous product with D50 ≈ 88.9 μm, then phase transformation to quartz and cristobalite after higher-temperature annealing.
infographic.watch_item: The particle size is relatively coarse for many spray processes, so additional milling/classification may be needed before practical thermal spray use.
infographic.paper_title: Synthesis of Amorphous and Crystalline Silicon Dioxide Powder Composites from Rice Husk Ash for Thermal Spray Deposit

zh-Hans.title: 利用稻壳灰合成用于热喷涂沉积的无定形与晶态二氧化硅粉体复合材料
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文通过化学处理并随后在800 °C下热处理3 h，从稻壳灰中合成二氧化硅（SiO₂）。采用X射线衍射（XRD）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）和激光衍射粒度分析研究了所合成硅灰的结构和物理化学性质。所合成的硅灰呈无定形结构，中位粒径（D50）约为88.9 μm。随后在1200 °C下退火导致硅灰晶化，形成石英和方石英相。FTIR分析显示，在1000–1100 cm⁻¹区域存在与Si–O–Si伸缩振动相关的特征吸收带，以及可归因于羟基的吸收带。所得晶态硅材料表明其有望用作热喷涂技术中的粉体材料。

infographic.key_insight: 稻壳灰可转化为硅粉体，经800 °C处理后为无定形态，经过1200 °C退火后转变为晶态石英/方石英。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这为热喷涂粉体开发提供了一种低成本、源自废弃物的原料，并且相控制有助于调节涂层前驱体性能。
method: 通过化学处理从稻壳灰中提取SiO2。
将提取材料在800 °C下热处理3 h，以获得无定形二氧化硅。
在1200 °C下退火，以促使其晶化为石英和方石英。
infographic.evidence_signal: XRD、FTIR和激光衍射表明，该产物为无定形材料，D50 ≈ 88.9 μm；在更高温退火后发生相变，形成石英和方石英。
infographic.watch_item: 该粒径对许多喷涂工艺而言相对较粗，因此在实际热喷涂使用前可能需要进一步磨细/分级。

title: Structure and properties of AlB12-Al detonation coatings on steel 45
authors: Oleksandr Umanskyi, В. Б. Муратов, Vladimir E. Shelud'ko, K.N. Haltsov, А. А. Бондаренко, T. V. Mosina
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of the properties of detonation coatings AlB12-30 wt.% Al (AB70) and AlB12-70 wt.% Al (AB30) applied to 45 Steel using the DNEPR-5M installation. The coatings have the following characteristics: thickness h ~ 170-200 μm, Hμ = 27-29 GPa, HV = 4.35 GPa. Changes in the tribological characteristics of the composites depending on the friction mode are analyzed. The AB70 composition was found to have stable tribological characteristics: f = 0.21-0.38, wear rate I = 3.3-8.6 μm/km. Coated samples outperform uncoated 45 steel in wear resistance. Changes in the surface structure after friction are shown depending on the sliding speed and load. Two wear mechanisms have been identified: oxidative and adhesive-abrasive. It was concluded that it is possible to use the AlB12-Al system for applying detonation coatings.

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed AlB12–Al coatings on 45 steel deliver high hardness and notably improved wear resistance, with the AlB12–30 wt.% Al composition showing the most stable tribological behavior.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results support AlB12–Al detonation coatings as a practical surface-engineering route for extending steel component life under friction and wear.
method: Applied AlB12–30 wt.% Al (AB70) and AlB12–70 wt.% Al (AB30) detonation coatings onto 45 steel using the DNEPR-5M system.
Evaluated coating thickness, microhardness, hardness, friction coefficient, and wear rate under different sliding speeds and loads.
Compared worn-surface structure and wear mechanisms after testing.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports coating thickness of about 170–200 μm, μH = 27–29 GPa, HV = 4.35 GPa, and for AB70 a friction coefficient of 0.21–0.38 with wear rate of 3.3–8.6 μm/km, outperforming uncoated 45 steel.
infographic.watch_item: Wear behavior varies with friction mode, and the observed oxidative versus adhesive-abrasive mechanisms suggest performance will depend strongly on service conditions.
infographic.paper_title: Structure and properties of AlB12-Al detonation coatings on steel 45

zh-Hans.title: 45号钢上AlB12-Al爆炸涂层的结构与性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文致力于研究采用DNEPR-5M装置施加于45号钢上的AlB12-30 wt.% Al（AB70）和AlB12-70 wt.% Al（AB30）爆炸涂层的性能。涂层具有以下特征：厚度h ~ 170-200 μm，Hμ = 27-29 GPa，HV = 4.35 GPa。分析了复合材料摩擦学特性随摩擦模式变化的规律。结果表明，AB70组分具有稳定的摩擦学特性：f = 0.21-0.38，磨损率I = 3.3-8.6 μm/km。涂覆样品的耐磨性优于未涂覆的45号钢。给出了摩擦后表面结构随滑动速度和载荷变化的情况。识别出两种磨损机制：氧化磨损和黏着-磨粒磨损。结论认为，AlB12-Al体系可用于制备爆炸涂层。

infographic.key_insight: 施加在45号钢上的AlB12–Al爆炸喷涂涂层具有高硬度和显著提升的耐磨性，其中AlB12–30 wt.% Al组分表现出最稳定的摩擦学行为。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果支持将AlB12–Al爆炸涂层作为一种实用的表面工程途径，用于延长钢制部件在摩擦磨损条件下的服役寿命。
method: 采用DNEPR-5M系统将AlB12–30 wt.% Al（AB70）和AlB12–70 wt.% Al（AB30）爆炸涂层施加到45号钢上。
在不同滑动速度和载荷下评估涂层厚度、显微硬度、硬度、摩擦系数和磨损率。
测试后比较磨损表面结构和磨损机制。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告涂层厚度约为170–200 μm，μH = 27–29 GPa，HV = 4.35 GPa；其中AB70的摩擦系数为0.21–0.38，磨损率为3.3–8.6 μm/km，优于未涂覆的45号钢。
infographic.watch_item: 磨损行为随摩擦模式而变化，观察到的氧化磨损与黏着-磨粒磨损机制表明，性能将强烈依赖于服役条件。
